subject.title: feat(workspace): add tiered bootstrap loading with configurable bootstrapTier

question: Should OpenClaw accept `agents.defaults.bootstrapTier` as a new default-level config surface for controlling bootstrap file injection across session types?
rationale: The implementation is plausible and compatible by default, but adding another `agents.defaults` context knob is a product/config-policy choice that automation should not approve on its own.

options.title: Accept with docs and refreshed checks
options.body: Land the default-level `bootstrapTier` design after documenting it publicly and refreshing validation against current `main`.

options.title: Narrow or redesign the surface
options.body: Ask for a different shape, such as tying this to existing context controls or a more specific session policy before adding a new config key.

options.title: Decline the new config knob
options.body: Keep the linked issue open or close it as not planned if maintainers do not want this additional bootstrap policy surface.

recommendation.title: Accept with docs and refreshed checks
recommendation.body: Land the default-level `bootstrapTier` design after documenting it publicly and refreshing validation against current `main`.
